patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Adds a dark mode that follows the system dark theme. Web pages shown in the app are darkened, and optionally the native parts of the app.

options.title: Darken native UI
options.description: Let Android automatically darken the parts of the app that are not web pages, such as the search bar and the bottom navigation bar. Turn this off if these parts of the app look wrong.
